question: Has gap G001 already been addressed: No public benchmark evaluates retrieval over overlapping successive regulatory revisions with per-passage version labels and an in-force ground truth. Existing resources either score end answers on synthetic statutory questions (arxiv:2605.23497), measure gold-passage recall on Wikipedia/tennis versions (arxiv:2401.13222), or test temporal QA over non-versioned snippets (doi:10.1145/3589335.3651895).?
rationale: A gap is only a hypothesis until a targeted search fails to find work that closes it.
